inputs.name: integral definition
inputs.quote: d = T × d_continuous = T × [∫ μ(x) × l(x) × v(x) dx / ∫ l(x) × v(x) dx]

inputs.name: Hancock cancellation

quote: Day's d = mean cumulative hazard at the age of mothers (0.789 vs 0.784)
d*s is exact (V1, T*dr/s = 0.778 vs d = 0.789, within 1.5%)

day.reading: d is defined (Ch.13, App. A, Z18166234) and dimensionless; Hancock's d = 25 is not Day's d

notes: d x s is exact for hazard-scale s and the factor is 1 for per-generation s (R4 C2); which scale the aDNA s values use was not retrieved, so the choice stays with the claim verdicts (A4, A4f).
